description: Scaffold the Flutter project, replace pubspec.yaml with pinned dependencies, and set up core infrastructure: AppConfig, Dio API client, typed AppException hierarchy, base widgets, GoRouter with all routes, theme, and app entry point. This is the foundation all other FEATs depend on.
steps: Step 1 — Create the Flutter project. From /Users/testbedmac1/philldevcoder/projects/proofBuy-AI/, run: flutter create mobile --org com.proofbuy --project-name proofbuy_ai. This creates /Users/testbedmac1/philldevcoder/projects/proofBuy-AI/mobile/ with the default structure.

Step 2 — Replace mobile/pubspec.yaml entirely with the exact dependency versions specified. Dependencies: flutter sdk, flutter_riverpod ^2.6.1, riverpod_annotation ^2.6.1, go_router ^14.6.3, dio ^5.7.0, freezed_annotation ^2.4.4, json_annotation ^4.9.0, flutter_secure_storage ^9.2.2, cached_network_image ^3.4.1, url_launcher ^6.3.1, intl ^0.19.0, shared_preferences ^2.3.3. Dev dependencies: flutter_test sdk, flutter_lints ^5.0.0, build_runner ^2.4.13, freezed ^2.5.7, json_serializable ^6.9.0, riverpod_generator ^2.6.1, mocktail ^1.0.4.
Step 3 — Run `flutter pub get` in mobile/ to download all packages.

Step 4 — Create mobile/lib/core/config/app_config.dart with AppConfig class containing a static backendUrl getter that reads BACKEND_URL from dart-define with default 'http://10.0.2.2:8000'. Never hardcode localhost or 127.0.0.1.

Step 5 — Create mobile/lib/core/errors/app_exception.dart. Define a sealed class AppException with subtypes: NetworkException(message), ServerException(statusCode, message), NotFoundException(message), ValidationException(message), PaymentException(message). All extend AppException.

Step 6 — Create mobile/lib/core/networking/api_client.dart. Create a Dio instance using baseUrl from AppConfig.backendUrl, connectTimeout and receiveTimeout both 30 seconds. Add a request interceptor that logs '[REQ] method url body' in debug mode only (using kDebugMode from flutter/foundation.dart). Add a response/error interceptor that maps DioException to typed AppException: DioExceptionType.connectionTimeout or receiveTimeout → NetworkException; status 404 → NotFoundException; status 422 → ValidationException; status 402 → PaymentException; other 4xx/5xx → ServerException(statusCode, message). Export a top-level `final dio = createDio();` instance. Also create a Riverpod provider: `@riverpod Dio apiClient(ApiClientRef ref) => dio;`
Step 7 — Create mobile/lib/core/widgets/loading_widget.dart: a stateless widget that renders a centered Column with CircularProgressIndicator and optional String message below it in grey text.

Step 8 — Create mobile/lib/core/widgets/error_widget.dart (class name ProofBuyErrorWidget to avoid collision with Flutter's built-in ErrorWidget): renders an error icon (Icons.error_outline, red), a message Text, and a TextButton 'Retry' that calls a required VoidCallback onRetry.
Step 9 — Create mobile/lib/core/widgets/empty_state_widget.dart: renders a centered Column with an icon (default Icons.search_off), a message Text, and an optional subtitle.

Step 10 — Create mobile/lib/app/theme.dart. Define a ProofBuyTheme class with static ThemeData lightTheme and darkTheme. Primary: #1A73E8, Secondary: #34A853, Error: #EA4335. Also define a ProofBuyColors class with static const Color pass = Color(0xFF34A853), fail = Color(0xFFEA4335), unknown = Color(0xFFFBBC04), surface = Color(0xFFFFFFFF), background = Color(0xFFF8F9FA).

Step 11 — Create stub screen files (empty Scaffold with AppBar title) for every screen referenced in the router. Create these files now so the router compiles: mobile/lib/features/onboarding/onboarding_screen.dart, mobile/lib/features/shopping_brief/shopping_brief_screen.dart, mobile/lib/features/product_search/product_search_screen.dart, mobile/lib/features/product_comparison/product_comparison_screen.dart, mobile/lib/features/product_details/product_details_screen.dart, mobile/lib/features/purchase_review/purchase_review_screen.dart, mobile/lib/features/checkout/checkout_screen.dart, mobile/lib/features/checkout/checkout_return_screen.dart, mobile/lib/features/transaction_result/transaction_result_screen.dart, mobile/lib/features/transaction_history/history_screen.dart, mobile/lib/features/settings/settings_screen.dart. Each takes any route params it needs as constructor args (see router step for params).

Step 12 — Create mobile/lib/app/router.dart using GoRouter. Add a static bool _firstLaunch = true; field to detect first launch (reset after initial navigation). Define these routes: '/' redirects to '/onboarding' if _firstLaunch else '/brief'. '/onboarding' → OnboardingScreen. '/brief' → ShoppingBriefScreen. '/loading/:sessionId' → ProductSearchScreen(sessionId: state.pathParameters['sessionId']!). '/results/:sessionId' → ProductComparisonScreen(sessionId: state.pathParameters['sessionId']!). '/product/:productResultId' → ProductDetailsScreen(productResultId: state.pathParameters['productResultId']!). '/review/:productResultId' → PurchaseReviewScreen(productResultId: state.pathParameters['productResultId']!). '/checkout/:purchaseId' → CheckoutScreen(purchaseId: state.pathParameters['purchaseId']!, orderId: state.uri.queryParameters['orderId']??''). '/checkout/return' → CheckoutReturnScreen(). '/transaction/:purchaseId' → TransactionResultScreen(purchaseId: state.pathParameters['purchaseId']!). '/history' → HistoryScreen(). '/settings' → SettingsScreen(). Enable deep link handling in GoRouter: set the scheme to 'proofbuy' using initialLocation and add a deepLinkTransformer to handle 'proofbuy://checkout/return' as '/checkout/return'.

Step 13 — Create mobile/lib/app/app.dart. ProofBuyApp is a ConsumerWidget that builds MaterialApp.router using GoRouter from app/router.dart, lightTheme/darkTheme from theme.dart, and title 'ProofBuy AI'.
Step 14 — Replace mobile/lib/main.dart. Load ProviderScope wrapping ProofBuyApp. runApp called inside main() which is synchronous. No hardcoded URLs.

Step 15 — Configure Android deep links in mobile/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. Inside the main <activity> block, add an <intent-filter> with android:autoVerify='true' containing: <action android:name='android.intent.action.VIEW'/>, <category android:name='android.intent.category.DEFAULT'/>, <category android:name='android.intent.category.BROWSABLE'/>, <data android:scheme='proofbuy' android:host='checkout' android:pathPrefix='/return'/>.

Step 16 — Run `flutter pub get` then `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` in mobile/. (No generated files yet from Freezed at this stage — this just verifies build_runner runs without error.)
Step 17 — Run `flutter analyze` and fix any reported errors. Common at this stage: unused import warnings (ok to leave as warnings), missing override annotations.
acceptance_criteria: `flutter analyze` reports 0 errors (warnings are acceptable) in mobile/
`flutter test` passes (default generated widget test may need updating to reference ProofBuyApp)
findings: build_runner / riverpod_generator ^2.6.1 is pinned to analyzer 7.6.0 (Dart 3.9 max) which is incompatible with the installed Dart SDK 3.13.0 — DotShorthandPropertyAccess AST node not handled. Workaround: removed @riverpod annotation from api_client.dart and replaced with a hand-written Provider<Dio> (apiClientProvider). riverpod_annotation and riverpod_generator remain in pubspec for later FEATs once those packages ship a compatible release. All four verification commands exit 0: flutter pub get, flutter analyze (0 issues), flutter test (1 passed), flutter build apk --debug (app-debug.apk produced).
